model_annotation: Figure 1 presents the price of a fiscal rule index for Germany and synthetic controls from 1995 to 2017. The x-axis represents time in years, with a linear scale ranging from 1995 to 2017, with tick marks at yearly intervals. The y-axis represents the fiscal rule index, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. There are three lines displayed in the figure. The first line, representing Germany, is solid and blue, starting at a value of approximately 0.2 in 1995 and ending at a value of approximately 0.6 in 2017. This line shows a generally increasing trend with fluctuations, reaching a peak of approximately 0.7 in 2000, a decrease to approximately 0.4 in 2003, and then a steady increase to 2017. The second line, representing the synthetic control, is dashed and red, starting at a value of approximately 0.2 in 1995 and ending at a value of approximately 0.5 in 2017. This line also shows an increasing trend with fluctuations, reaching a peak of approximately 0.6 in 1999 and a low of approximately 0.3 in 2004. The third line, representing the 95% confidence interval around the synthetic control, is shaded in gray, fluctuating between approximately 0.1 and 0.7 throughout the period.
